caveat: This is a hypothesis/evidence mapping and not an executable dependency graph or method priority queue.

families.name: Frozen-Wan signed FFN joint-function predictability
families.information: Q1 QDQ current q plus weight stats; output labels post W2 only offline
families.cost: online metadata/decision plus any hidden read; legitimate whole group Q2 and W1/W2 layout
families.observed: Original fullM support and local/global signed discrepancies; candidate remains OPEN
families.falsifier: No held-out signed functional gain over simple q/step/source baseline at lower cost than native packed dense kernel

families.name: Signed code histograms and conditional tight W1 sign interval
families.information: signed multisets available only after current activation quantization; per-row scale intersections
families.cost: weight histogram memory; current input histogram; up to MHD/B queries plus adaptive aligned code pair reads
families.observed: Rearrangement tight per output row over unknown pair alignments; joint rows not tight, no native Wan certification measured
families.falsifier: Intervals cross zero or acquiring/using them costs at least exact GEMM

families.name: Paid lowprecision proxy decision then exact selected FFN computation
families.information: current pre-W1 q and extra approximate proxy weights
families.cost: INT4 proxy GEMVs, masks, original selected W1/W2; must preserve HiF4 Q2 group closure
families.observed: Prox LLM SwiGLU source benchmark only, not Wan original result
families.falsifier: Proxy information costs exceed savings or selected hidden breaks original Q2 and video quality

families.name: Code-domain lookup and partial sum algebra
families.information: packed bitplanes/vector codebooks plus live activation; source-specific quantization scales
families.cost: build LUT/psum, metadata gathers, kernel and cache plus fallback; not gratis dot
families.observed: LUT-GEMM and CodeGEMM source fast paths single vector, multi-token fallback dequant+cuBLAS/torch matmul
families.falsifier: No multi-token native packed code kernel beating same-format Tensor Core at fullM

families.name: Native quantized sparse dual GEMM and layout execution
families.information: current activation magnitudes and FP4/CUTLASS pack; not free sign hist skip
families.cost: sparse packing and sparse GEMM PLUS dense FP4 residual GEMM, two scale views, fusion and resource use
families.observed: SharQ 4x5090 T2V not same I2V; source full two GEMMs; unpaired benchmark and prefill slowdown shown
families.falsifier: Compared to dense native FP4 full operator is slower or fails free-running video fidelity

families.name: Training creates routable FFN functions
families.information: new trained selector/expert/tree parameters, teacher or video training
families.cost: training budget, online router/dispatch, new kernel and full video distillation/quality
families.observed: External architectures validated by authors on diverse different models, frozen Wan underlying structure still OPEN
families.falsifier: Equal-quality retrained structure fails actual FFN and video latency savings or cannot support motion

families.name: Step-specific compact models and static FFN width
families.information: step identity or trained architecture masks learned during distillation
families.cost: train, compact weight storage, per-step weight gather/union; actual shape reduced
families.observed: DIFS uses trained 8-wide channel chunk, distinct from HiF4 64-group; original Wan D-Q only 2 full experts
families.falsifier: Group scales, expert switching and total model quality degrade after compact conversion

families.name: Frame/block update instead of per-channel suppression
families.information: latent frame IDs and block/step schedule, trained SCD temporal representations
families.cost: gather/interpolate or separate encoder-renderer, attention and residual dependencies
families.observed: FIS-DiT Wan2.2 results T2V; SCD external causal model, neither original I2V unchanged
families.falsifier: Temporal interpolation/rendering degrades long-form appearance/motion or not faster under true shapes

families.name: Historical trajectory, residual, and MLP coefficient reuse
families.information: exact same-weight previous features and/or paid predictor/full compute refresh
families.cost: cache residence, refresh, historical proxy, multi-expert invalidation, self rollout
families.observed: L2P 50step FLUX whole output; SVDCache cached feature after full refresh; Chipmunk W1 paid proxy
families.falsifier: Student-prefix/seed changes invalidate reuse or hit rate too small in 4-step high/low

families.name: Realtime causal chunk FFN and system SLO
families.information: new causal student parameters, KV stream, current chunk/step/condition and legal history
families.cost: W4A4 GEMM + KV/cache/scheduler/VAE/transfer, p99 and TTFF, not whole clip FPS
families.observed: All examples are external; Wan2.2 TI2V-5B and Wan2.1 I2V14B differ from original A14B D-Q
families.falsifier: Saved FFN percentage doesn't lower end-to-end deadline misses or streaming video consistency

families.name: Frozen native quality evidence and method function acceptance
families.information: native matched source/seed independent full-depth 40x4 FFN and full-frame delivered video
families.cost: metrics, SHA-bound video, actual GPU source code and FP4/Tensor Core timing
families.observed: 10 source identities/12 nested seed paths/1920sites observed; prior local wins with terminal quality failure
families.falsifier: Method's local error reduction cannot survive full free-running video temporal and motion metrics

families.name: Physical FFN cost and 3-shape comparator
families.information: runtime actual M/K tiling, lowbit packing/Q1 scaling, data dispatch and device
families.cost: observer and code bytes, shape changes, launch/weight residency, packed native dense comparator
families.observed: fullM token-wise sparse posthoc 100% tile occupancy, kernel mix depends on shape
families.falsifier: The proposed observer costs more than physical work it avoids on matched hardware

validation_plan: Graph IDs must exist and no relation endpoints dangling
Paper IDs all unique and registered in primary index
Every external LIT comparison only links to SRC as comparison/conditional; never replacement
Do not imply all 79 original papers full text audited
No user-supplied downstream feedback without explicit native data
